old_caption: The video begins with a hand lifting the lid off a pot on a stovetop. The pot is black with a speckled pattern and has two handles. Inside the pot, there is a milky liquid that is actively boiling, with visible bubbles and foam. The stovetop is covered with aluminum foil, suggesting an effort to prevent spills or to keep the surface clean. The background includes a granite countertop with a speckled pattern, indicating a kitchen setting. The lighting is bright, highlighting the details of the pot and its contents. The video captures the moment of revealing the boiling liquid, emphasizing the activity of cooking.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a hand lifting the lid off a pot on a stovetop. The pot is black with a speckled pattern and has two handles. Inside the pot, there is a white liquid, likely milk or cream, which is gently simmering. The liquid appears smooth and is bubbling slightly at the edges. The stovetop is covered with aluminum foil, suggesting an effort to prevent spills or to keep the surface clean. The background includes a granite countertop with a speckled pattern, indicating a kitchen setting. The lighting is bright, highlighting the details of the pot and its contents. As the hand lifts the lid, steam rises from the pot, adding a dynamic element to the scene. The video captures the moment of revealing the simmering liquid, emphasizing the warmth and activity of cooking.
caption: A left hand grips the black knob of a transparent glass lid resting on a white-speckled black pot set on a foil-lined stovetop beside a granite counter. Through the steam-fogged glass a pale, foamy liquid churns beneath. The hand holds the knob steady, then lifts the lid upward and toward the left, tilting it so the rim clears the pot's edge. As the lid swings out of frame, motion blur streaks its glass surface and the open pot is exposed. With the cover gone, the white liquid continues to simmer, its frothy surface undulating and bubbling around a grainy patch at the center. Both black handles now sit within the frame, flanking the simmering contents. The foil backdrop and stove grates remain largely in place, with only slight framing drift. The foam rises and settles in slow, irregular waves across the surface. The uncovered pot keeps boiling steadily while the lid stays out of view.
